steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I know the beast you're talking about is Stella... Do you hate Stella because it's always causing trouble for you?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I know that Stella is always naughty. But it's my fault... I didn't... I didn't keep a close enough eye on it.
The girl thinks for a moment.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: But Stella is still young and got lost from its family. Stella is naughty because nobody taught it any better.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: From now on, OwO is Stella's family. I'll always be by its side, I will teach Stella to be good, and I will protect Stella.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I promise that Stella won't become a monster. Don't stay angry at Stella, please... please?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Th-thank you! I'll tell Stella not to make trouble for you anymore.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Stella, you're not allowed to be naughty and cause trouble for our little clapper ${PlayerName} anymore. You're both part of the film crew, so learn to get along.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: All right, Stella already apologized to you. I'm going to bed now. Yawn. So sleepy!
The girl walks off sleepily with the little critter in her arms. You gaze at them and wonder if you can really keep such a promise.
